sections.content: Selectors target elements to style: element names (p), classes (.card), ids (#main), and combinations (p.intro, div.card p).
Specificity order: id > class > element. When rules conflict, the most specific wins.
Key points: class selectors are the workhorse, descendant selectors (space) target nested elements, and :hover/:focus add interactivity.
Summary: Selectors — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
